# Kinexus CPAs & Advisors

> > Kinexus CPAs & Advisors is a St. George, Utah-based CPA firm serving small businesses, entrepreneurs, and individuals with accounting, tax, payroll, and advisory services tailored by industry and growth stage. Rather than positioning as a once-a-year compliance vendor, the firm blends year-round proactive tax planning, deep industry-specific expertise in construction, restaurants, real estate, and medical practices, and CFO-level business management advisory — aiming to be a full-spectrum financial partner for business growth and wealth building.
